areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, character-select screen, campaign menu, and local Steam profile folder.
areas.note: Chosen route: native Windows PC, including the PC-only guest roster; no secondary platform or emulation branch.

levels.1: Confirm the selected release and its free character update before creating the completion profile.
levels.2: Install the current Windows Steam version and verify the Left 4 Dead survivor update is present.
levels.3: Use the native Windows build selected in games.json; there is no secondary or emulated route. Update the game, open character selection, and confirm the eight guest survivors appear alongside the eight base characters before beginning.

levels.1: Protect the profile before short optional windows and cooperative cleanup.
levels.2: Close the game and copy Steam userdata\<user-id>\301640\remote\PC_ProfileSaves.
levels.3: Exit fully to desktop, copy the entire PC_ProfileSaves folder to a dated location outside Steam, and keep several milestone copies. Restore only while the game is closed so cloud synchronization cannot overwrite the selected branch.

levels.1: The campaign menu retains completed pickups and lets earlier locations be revisited.
levels.2: Open Campaign, choose any cleared chapter, and inspect its per-chapter pickup counters.
levels.3: Gold bars register when crossed and bottles register when shot; both persist immediately. Use chapter select to revisit any chapter whose local counters are incomplete, then finish or safely exit after confirming the counter changed.

levels.1: The lobby separates ballistic difficulty from the size of the enemy population.
levels.2: Review Cadet, Marksman, Sniper Elite, and the one-to-four-player Enemy Setup before launching.
levels.3: Cadet removes rifle ballistics, Marksman adds gravity and stance effects, and Sniper Elite adds wind plus stronger steadiness penalties. Enemy Setup controls population independently; use the one-player population for difficult cleanup, then sample the larger settings as separate custom variants.

levels.2: Across from the post-horde position, the bottle is on the right-hand third-floor ledge of the large wrecked house.
levels.3: Before entering the second safe room, cross to the wrecked house and climb the rubble slope beside it. Use the broken, sandbagged wall to sight the first ledge on the right side of the third floor, then shoot the bottle with any weapon.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: Opposite the church, the bottle rests on a projecting wooden beam at the top-right of the ruined building beyond the cemetery arch.
levels.3: Clear the church exterior but do not enter. Look across the street through the cemetery arch toward the ruined building, find the beam projecting from the top-right broken wall, and shoot the bottle from outside.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is visible through a narrow opening in the church's damaged roof spire.
levels.3: Remain outside the church and inspect the two spire-like roof structures. Aim through one of the thin openings in the destroyed spire and shoot the bottle before going inside.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on the floor beside a couch inside the building immediately right of the burning tank.
levels.3: After the first checkpoint and its horde, follow the street to the burning tank lodged in rubble. Enter the building on the tank's right; the bar is beside the couch just left of the entrance, and walking across it collects it.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is in the previously barred house's attic, beside a lit lantern and a Grossberg X2 shotgun.
levels.3: After the second checkpoint, enter the newly accessible house and finish the approaching wave before leaving. Climb to the third-floor attic, locate the lantern and shotgun, and walk across the bar lying beside them.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: At the razor-wire street end, the gold bar is in the non-dead-end entrance of the ruined building left of the burning-car barricade.
levels.3: Begin at the crossroads beside safe room two and choose the side street pointing away from the active route. Continue to the razor wire and burning cars, enter the ruined building on the barricade's left, ignore the entrance that stops immediately, and collect the bar from the floor beside the corpse and SVT-40 rifle.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is centered on the floor of the small building beside the spiked wall near the third safe room.
levels.3: On the approach to the third safe room, pass through the open iron gate and follow the adjoining spiked wall left. Enter the nearby small building and walk across the bar in the middle of its floor.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on the floor inside the doorway nearest the church on the long building outside its left side.
levels.3: Walk along the church's left exterior to the long building with three doorways. Use the doorway closest to the church; the bar is directly on the floor inside, so cross it once to collect it.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.

Use a scoped rifle through the window right of the exit door, aim to the far-right side of the street, and sight the bottle on the right side of the broken, burning building through gaps in the tree branches; leaving the room can remove this firing angle, so reload the checkpoint if necessary.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle sits on a lone stone ledge below the cathedral's first roof, beneath the long wooden beam that crosses above it.
levels.3: After clearing the wooden walkway, face the altar below and turn your view right. Trace the loose beams between the middle floor and altar to the long beam above the first roof; the bottle is on the solitary stone ledge below that roof, ready to be shot.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on the floor near a large mirror, two rooms to the right of the second-floor sniping point.
levels.3: From the second-floor firing position, enter the room on the right and continue into the next room farther right. Find the large mirror and walk across the bar on the floor nearby.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on the ground beside a corpse in the only available second-floor room above the first safe room.
levels.3: Leave the first safe room and climb through the upper floors. Before dropping through the opening in the wall, enter the only accessible room on the second floor and collect the bar lying beside the corpse.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is in the room off the left-hand hall immediately before the second safe room, held beside a corpse.
levels.3: As you approach the second safe room, stop before entering it and take the hall on the left within the same building. Go into the next room and walk across the bar beside the corpse's hand.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on the third floor beyond the second safe checkpoint, beside hands reaching through a barred doorway.
levels.3: Continue through the building after the second checkpoint until the doors ahead-right open, but do not pass through them. Take the stairs to the third floor, find the barred doorway with hands reaching through it, and collect the bar beside them.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is beside a corpse past the fireplace on the broken second-floor walkway of the building across from the next route marker.
levels.3: Enter the building across the street from the active route marker and remain on its second floor instead of leaving through the ground-floor wall opening. Follow the broken flooring past the fireplace to the corpse, then walk across the bar beside it.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.3: In the opening room, climb the three-tier metal scaffolding on the right. Check the landing below the upper tier and nearest the doorway where you entered, then walk across the bar.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.3: Finish the trainyard encounter, pass through the newly opened sealed door, and follow the walkway along the right. Enter the first room, clear the interruption, then collect the bar from the corner beside the wire spools and pallets.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.

levels.3: Leave the second safe room, turn around the corner on the left, and cross both rail lines to the hanging logs. Collect the bar underneath before shooting or dropping the logs; if they fall first, reload the checkpoint.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on a chair beneath the flag in the nearby building used by the chainsaw-wielding elite.
levels.3: Press the yard button, finish the wave, and pass through the opened gates. Enter the nearby building where the chainsaw sound originates, clear the room, then walk across the bar on the chair below the flag.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is inside a tall open crate against the second-floor outer wall of the gondola station, near ammunition boxes.
levels.3: After the station siege is completely resolved, enter its main room and climb to the second floor. Follow the building's outer interior edge to the tall open crates against the wall, then collect the bar from the one beside the ammunition boxes.

levels.1: Follow distant calls in the forest and inspect suspended figures before advancing.
levels.2: One figure is inside a wicker man right of the opening dead tree; ten more hang close together beyond the first safe room.
levels.3: Shoot the wicker-man figure before approaching the nearby house or finishing the first half of that encounter. After the first safe room, clear the hill and shoot all ten chained figures hanging in nearby trees; listen for remaining calls and count all ten before crossing the bridge.

areas.name: The Keep
areas.location_cue: A mountain fortress with outer paths, prison wine cellar, halls, crypt, and gondola station.
areas.note: Finish local optional work before following the main route; completed pickups persist for chapter-select cleanup.

levels.1: Follow the physical route to its exit while clearing each mandatory checkpoint.
levels.2: Reach the results screen for The Keep on any difficulty setting.
levels.3: Clear every mandatory checkpoint and continue until the results screen records completion. The result persists for chapter-select cleanup, so missing optional items can be revisited without erasing this clear.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is in a tower window on the Keep's left side, viewed after turning around at the sealed door atop the left side path.
levels.3: On the returning path, take the side route leading left and climb until a sealed door stops you. Turn around, face the Keep to the left, find the bottle nestled in the tower window, and shoot it.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is in the bottom-right corner of the far-right upper window used by the last summoner beyond the front gate bridge.
levels.3: Cross the rickety bridge beyond the front gates and clear the four elevated summoners plus their waves. Aim at the far-right window used by the last one, inspect the bottom-right corner of that dark opening, and shoot the faint bottle near the wall's upper-right side.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is in the leftmost candle-lit alcove of the crypt's circular wall beyond the blasted cave entrance.
levels.3: Open the cave entrance, clear the chamber, and use the ceiling opening to reach the crypt's circular line of small alcoves. Face the leftmost alcove beside the lit candles and shoot the bottle inside; the same crypt contains the separate hidden-treasure interaction.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is among the ordinary bottles on the left shelf inside the wine cellar unlocked by restoring power beneath the kitchen stairs.
levels.3: Note the locked wine-cellar door, continue upstairs through the next door, clear the kitchen, and activate the power console under the left side of the stairs nearest the entrance. Return to the now-open cellar, shoot the cluster of regular bottles on the left shelf, and hit the collectible concealed among them.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is inside the prison cell after its survivor has been freed with the wine-cellar key.
levels.3: Speak to the prisoner near the first safe room, clear the larger enemy from the far cellar room, and take the key from that room's table. Unlock the cell, wait for the rescue to register, then enter the empty cell and collect the bar.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is on a desk inside the hidden room revealed by the rear bookshelf in the first left-hand room beyond the upper Tesla chamber.
levels.3: Reach the upper machinery room and speak to the stranded survivor, then turn around and take the first door on the left. Continue through the next door into the upper room overlooking the suit-lined hall, use the first left doorway, interact with the bookshelves at the back to reveal the hidden room, and collect the bar from its desk.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is concealed in the rack at the rear of the basement torture room beneath the upper hall's far-right altar room.
levels.3: Return to the upper level of the main hall instead of continuing beyond the hidden-room area. Enter the far-right corner door, cross the altar room, use the next doorway and its stairs to the basement, then interact with the rack at the torture room's rear to expose and collect the bar.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is tucked beneath the arm of the body on the rear operating table in the laboratory beyond the machinery room.
levels.3: Find all five explosive charges, use four on the machinery, and leave the room after detonation. Enter the laboratory beyond, go to the operating table at the back, and collect the bar hidden under the body's arm.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is behind the blastable rock spot along the outer wall right of the reopened front gates, near the earlier supply bodies.
levels.3: Keep the fifth explosive charge instead of spending it on the four-charge machinery step. During the timed escape, open the front gates, follow the outer wall right toward the earlier supply-search area, attach the spare charge to the marked rocks, detonate it, and collect the exposed bar before the timer expires.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins with the uniformed survivor inside the building immediately left of the starting position.
levels.3: Enter the left-hand building at the start and speak to the uniformed survivor. Leave the building, follow the path toward the explosive charges, and loot the bodies there until the dropped supplies register.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins back with the uniformed survivor after the dropped supplies have been recovered.
levels.3: Carry the supplies from the bodies back to the opening left-hand building. Speak to the uniformed survivor again and complete the hand-in before continuing.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins with the seated survivor beside the supply officer in the opening left-hand building.
levels.3: Speak to the seated survivor to learn about the crypt treasure. Later, enter the blasted cave, clear the crypt, interact with the coffin once to open it and a second time to take the concealed treasure; keep it until the gondola-station hand-in.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins by speaking to the prisoner in the first cell nearest the safe room inside the wine cellar.
levels.3: Pass through the first safe room, clear the wine cellar, open the door closest to that safe room, and speak through the cell. Leave the room and defeat the larger enemy that emerges from the far cellar room to register this stage.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins in the far wine-cellar room used by the prison guard.
levels.3: After completing the prisoner's combat request, enter the room from which the larger enemy emerged. Take the prison key from the table inside and verify the pickup before backtracking.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins back at the occupied wine-cellar cell after obtaining the prison key.
levels.3: Return to the first cell near the safe room and use the recovered key on its lock. Wait for the prisoner to leave and for the rescue to register before moving deeper into the Keep.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins when a survivor calls from the upper balcony after the floating skulls are cleared from the banquet hall.
levels.3: Enter the banquet hall, destroy every floating skull, and clear the enemies released when the doors open. Watch the upper balcony for the survivor's call, then immediately shoot the two attackers on that level before either reaches the position; reload if the rescue fails.

levels.1: Listen for calls and complete nearby optional interactions before advancing the main route.
levels.2: The task begins with the treasure requester at the gondola station after the area has been secured.
levels.3: Carry the crypt treasure through the mission, reach the gondola station, and clear every hostile there. Return the treasure to the waiting survivor and finish the conversation to complete the final hand-in.

levels.1: Scan a distant tower from the opening position before walking toward the fortress.
levels.2: At the start, look right to the lone tower below the Keep and find three ravens around the skeleton in its window.
levels.3: Bring a fast-firing scoped rifle, aim from the opening position, and shoot the left raven first. The other two immediately fly in different directions; hit both in the air, or restart the checkpoint and repeat before advancing.

levels.1: Follow the physical route to its exit while clearing each mandatory checkpoint.

levels.3: Clear every mandatory checkpoint and continue until the results screen records completion. The result persists for chapter-select cleanup, so missing optional items can be revisited without erasing this clear.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is beside a burning skeleton on the ledge ahead, just before the first tunnel drop.
levels.3: Push the large boulder at the start and enter the tunnel. Stop before dropping from its far end, aim toward the skeleton and fire on the ledge ahead, and shoot the bottle beside it.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is on the long steel beam above the leftmost upper conveyor in the large factory room.
levels.3: Enter the factory-like room with corpse conveyors and stand in its centre where the path bends right, between the two lower belts. Look above the second pair of belts moving in the opposite direction, find the long beam over the upper-left conveyor, and shoot the bottle.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: The bottle is at the left end of the pipe above the two short pipe arches between the four hydraulic machines.
levels.3: After the first safe room, follow the upper walkways and turn right across the bridge running between four hydraulic machines. Pass under the two short pipe arches, turn around, look up at the pipe spanning above them, and shoot the bottle near the cylindrical fitting at its left end.

levels.1: Pause at open sightlines and scan high architecture, signs, ledges, and distant structures.
levels.2: In the final vault, the bottle is among the spikes in the upper alcove right of the central barrier.
levels.3: From the vault's entrance side, face the large central barrier and look toward its upper section. Shift your aim to the spike-filled alcove on the right and shoot the bottle concealed among the spikes.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is in the middle bunker's side room beside the figure striking a control panel.
levels.3: Descend through the tunnel, activate the manual door override, and finish both sides of the following assault. Ignore the gates within the bunker, take the switchback route across the chasm into the previously inaccessible middle bunker, enter its side room, and collect the bar beside the control panel.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is in the room behind the large ventilation fan, on the right side of the vent shaft.
levels.3: Pass the main gates and decontamination room, then clear the chamber overlooking the fan. Drop to the fan, destroy it with gunfire and the resulting blast, enter the exposed vent shaft, and collect the bar in the room on the right beyond it.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is in the corner of the rail-side garbage pit to the right of the bridge encounter.
levels.3: After dropping into the bridge encounter, the heavy enemies continue spawning and do not need to be cleared. Break right, run to the rail-side refuse pit, enter it, and collect the bar from its corner before escaping the area.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is at the dead end reached by taking the left passage, climbing two levels, and turning left again in the post-siege dig site.
levels.3: Pass the second safe room, open the dig-site tunnels, and survive the siege. When the route changes to placing the relic, do not place it yet; take the passage on the left, climb two levels, turn left around the corner, and collect the bar at the dead end.

levels.1: Check side rooms, dead ends, and furnished corners before committing to the main route.
levels.2: The gold bar is behind the second doorway on the right in the final vault, opened by throwing the third-safe-room skeleton into the central pit.
levels.3: Inside the third safe room, reload first and pick up the skeleton from the floor. Carry it without swapping the held object all the way to the final vault, wait until the central pit can be approached, throw the skeleton into the pit, then enter the newly opened second doorway on the right and collect the bar.

areas.name: Horde Mode
areas.location_cue: The standalone Horde menu, map-selection screen, and wave counter.
areas.note: Each environment is endless; Wave 10 is the finite recorded milestone, with two additional cooperative score records.

levels.1: Learn the ammunition routes and retreat lanes before the heavier waves arrive.
levels.2: Start No Sanctuary from Wave 1 and reach the beginning of Wave 10.
levels.3: Choose Cadet and the one-player enemy population, start No Sanctuary no later than Wave 1, and survive nine complete waves so Wave 10 begins. The mode continues endlessly afterward, so reaching Wave 10 is the finite completion mark; leaving after it registers does not create another missed ending.
